gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla keeps its s curves wide and barely curled in, friendly and modern. Anek Bangla over Revalia's bold, loosely spaced display letters reads easily, a quiet body under a loud heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anuphan: Expressive from the first glance, Revalia stretches its tall letters out with a relaxed stride and an open-tailed g. Yet Anuphan does the opposite job well, with big round lowercase bowls and clear gaps that stay clean.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: Revalia's open-tailed g and widely separated letters give the heading a loose, swaggering stride. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono follows with clipped capitals and ascenders, and its open counters let the text breathe.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-chivo: Approachable, despite Revalia's bold display swagger up top. And Chivo's sans-serif lowercase, packed up toward the caps with daylight in every curve, keeps the text smooth to read.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Big, loud and loose: Revalia sprawls its letters wide. But Chocolate Classical Sans holds the quiet end, with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-duru-sans: Loud, loose and tall-banded, Revalia leads. Duru Sans brings the opposite strength: wide openings on small letters, with bodies that dominate the line while ascenders hardly show.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-funnel-sans: Showy letters, then a calm worker. Revalia's low, wide display shapes meet Funnel Sans, whose strokes stay put from stem to curve and whose e opens like a pried clasp.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-gidole: Revalia sprawls with a relaxed stride. Gidole answers with neon-tube consistency in every stroke, terminals held apart like open scissor blades, and a high-set midline.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable, with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals and a wide gap where the c ends. And Revalia sits against it as the bold, expressive one, loose and stretched.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-heebo: Neutral and level-headed, Heebo holds a tall central band of text with curves that stop short instead of closing in. And Revalia's bold, widely spaced display letters lead the way above it.
